notes: The snapshot is the moveit2 repository; the package is at moveit_setup_assistant/moveit_setup_controllers (version 2.5.3). It is a MoveIt Setup Assistant plugin: the packet elements are not declared as ROS parameters (no declare_parameter in the package); they are keys the package writes into the generated file config/moveit_controllers.yaml (MoveItControllersConfig::GeneratedControllersConfig::writeYaml, src/moveit_controllers_config.cpp:147-216), which is also parsed back by loadPrevious (lines 44-99, parseController 104-142). QoS, rate, units and definition_id do not apply to these YAML parameter keys and are null. Only moveit_simple_controller_manager.controller_names has a fully literal name in code (lines 169, 172), so it is the only entry in declares. The other four elements follow the template moveit_simple_controller_manager.<controller name>.{type,joints,action_ns,default}, where <controller name> is supplied at run time (typed by the user in the GUI, validated by regex "[^a-z|^1-9|^_]" at src/controllers_widget.cpp:616; auto-generated as <group>_controller at src/controllers.cpp:64; or loaded from an existing moveit_controllers.yaml). The string rotate_joint_controller occurs nowhere in the snapshot, so these four are in neither declares nor not_declared. What the code declares for the template, for the record: <controller name>.type is std::string (controllers_config.hpp:54), emitted at moveit_controllers_config.cpp:189 always; <controller name>.joints is std::vector<std::string> (controllers_config.hpp:55), emitted as a YAML sequence at lines 191-200 always (parser also accepts a scalar, lines 126-133); <controller name>.action_ns and <controller name>.default are entries of std::map<std::string, std::string> parameters_ (controllers_config.hpp:56), emitted as strings at lines 202-206 only when present in that map. They are present when the controller was saved through the edit widget (ControllerEditWidget::getAdditionalParameters always sets both keys, src/controller_edit_widget.cpp:270-280, possibly as empty strings; defaults on type change: action_ns = follow_joint_trajectory for FollowJointTrajectory, gripper_cmd for GripperCommand, empty otherwise; default = "true"; moveit_controllers.hpp:88-114) or when they were in a loaded file (moveit_controllers_config.cpp:116-122, read with as<std::string>()). Controllers created by the Auto Add button (Controllers::addDefaultControllers, src/controllers.cpp:46-69 -> ControllersConfig::addController(name,type,joints), src/controllers_config.cpp:45-53) have an empty parameters_ map, so no action_ns or default key is written for them. The default key is stored and emitted as the string "true", not as a bool. Array-typed params are written as string[] in declares. references is empty: none of the packet elements is consumed; the package also writes the value moveit_simple_controller_manager/MoveItSimpleControllerManager for key moveit_controller_manager (line 164-165), which is not a packet element. exclusive is empty: the package generates ros2_control xacro/yaml configuration but claims no hardware interface or device handle itself.
